source_count_definition: Number of surviving source artifacts, not independent experiments or statistical replicates. Nested stages, summaries and reruns can overlap.
extraction: Numeric/boolean/null trees and selected categorical fields from measurement reports. Raw requests, text outputs, message/session IDs, environment, credentials and private paths excluded. Historical source errors remain historical observations; see curation notes.
original_sources: Retained privately; SHA256 identifies the original bytes. Public extracts are not byte-identical raw logs or an exact public replay.
